notes.name: Recipe - Bisi bele bath for forty
notes.body: forty boxes: three kilos rice, two kilos toor dal, the bisi bele masala from Hamid, ghee at the end, boondi on the side

notes.name: Recipe - Sambar masala batch
notes.body: roast the coriander and chana dal first, grind with red chillies and fenugreek, store in two jars, one for the kitchen and one for the Powai kitchen

notes.name: Recipe - Neer dosa batter
notes.body: raw rice soaked four hours, a cup of grated coconut, thin batter like buttermilk, no fermenting, make fresh every Saturday

notes.name: Recipe - Chapati dough for 150
notes.body: ten kilos atta, salt, oil, hot water, rest forty minutes, Savitha rolls and Lalitha cooks on the two tawas

notes.name: Recipe - Jain thali rules
notes.body: no onion, no garlic, no roots, fruits only after sunset is not served, separate utensils, Sunita Kulkarni's thali goes in the green carrier

notes.name: Recipe - Sunday special - ghee rice and kurma
notes.body: ghee rice with cashews, vegetable kurma, boondi raita, gulab jamun when the order is above forty

notes.name: Recipe - Payasa for festivals
notes.body: semiya payasa for the staff on festival days, one litre milk per five boxes, cardamom and saffron from the Diwali stock

notes.name: Recipe - Pickle and gojju ratios
notes.body: mango gojju and lime pickle jars for the Mangaluru customers, a spoon per box

notes.name: Opening checklist
notes.body: gas on, floors washed, aprons and caps, hand wash, temperature log, rice soaking started

notes.name: Closing checklist
notes.body: gas off, drains cleaned, leftover food to the temple, dabbas soaked, notice for tomorrow

notes.name: Hygiene rules
notes.body: caps on, nails short, no phones in the cooking area, FSSAI poster in the corridor

notes.name: Gas safety
notes.body: check the pipe every Monday, never store cylinders near the tawa, Dinesh's number on the wall

notes.name: Stock thresholds
notes.body: rice below 40 kilos, oil below two tins, dal below 15 kilos: order the same day

notes.name: Delivery route sheet - BKC
notes.body: four drop-offs by 12:15, Ramu takes towers A and B, Suresh the food court and the clinic

notes.name: Suresh Gupta's rates 2026
notes.body: basmati 94 a kilo, sona masoori 58, toor dal 142, he wants payment by the fifth

notes.name: Ganesh bhaji wala credit
notes.body: pays every second Saturday, keeps a diary, last year's festival season was 11000 extra

notes.name: Dipak Jain steel dabba price list
notes.body: four-compartment 310, three-compartment 260, lids 40, minimum order 50

notes.name: Milk vendor timings
notes.body: Ramesh Patil delivers at 5:30, double on Sundays, bill on the third

notes.name: Chirag Vora box sizes
notes.body: small 12 rupees, medium 16, large 22, printed lid 4 extra, two weeks lead time

notes.name: Shreya Iyer's diet plan
notes.body: low oil, no fried items, extra salad, a boiled egg on Tuesdays and Thursdays

notes.name: Night-shift nurses timings
notes.body: Sion hospital group takes boxes at 21:30 and 03:30, Mohammed Shaikh is the contact

notes.name: Kavita Rao office lunch count
notes.body: Powai office takes 14 boxes Monday to Friday, count by 9:30 the same day

notes.name: PG customers in Matunga
notes.body: Mohamed Sheikh collects for twelve rooms, pays monthly in cash on the first

notes.name: Customers on pause in January
notes.body: three families away for Sankranti, restart on the 18th

notes.name: Advik's cricket schedule
notes.body: nets on Saturdays at five, matches on the second Sunday, kit bag in the hall cupboard

notes.name: Anvi's dance recital costume
notes.body: red lehenga from the tailor, hair accessories, rehearsal on Thursday after class

notes.name: School supply list 2026
notes.body: notebooks, brown paper, geometry box, two compass sets, labels for everything

notes.name: PTM notes - Advik
notes.body: Meghna ma'am says he rushes the maths, reading is good, wants him in the quiz team

notes.name: Pappa's medicines
notes.body: BP tablet morning, sugar tablet after dinner, refill every 28 days from Dr Kulkarni's chemist

notes.name: Ajji's diet
notes.body: no fried, soft rice, buttermilk at lunch, walk to the balcony after dinner

notes.name: Amma's physio exercises
notes.body: ankle rotations, leg raises, ten minutes twice a day, the physio calls on Fridays

notes.name: Atthe's pickle recipe
notes.body: raw mango, mustard, fenugreek, chilli powder, sesame oil, sun for five days

notes.name: Ganpati 2026 plan
notes.body: idol booked, lights by Chirag's cousin, prasad from our kitchen, visarjan on the fifth day

notes.name: Diwali box pricing
notes.body: small box 450, medium 750, large 1200, corporate orders above fifty get five percent off

notes.name: Temple annadanam roster
notes.body: Krishna mandir needs 300 plates on the first Saturday, Panditji sends the list on Thursday

notes.name: Diary entry - rough Monday
notes.body: Gas delivery late, Ramu's scooter broke down, two customers paused, bed at midnight.

notes.name: Diary entry - good Sunday
notes.body: Society meeting went fine, Mahila Mandal on Sunday, called Amma twice, Anvi danced.

notes.name: Mangaluru house repair list
notes.body: roof leak above the kitchen, new gate lock, repaint the front room, termite check

notes.name: Scooter details
notes.body: three Activas and one Jupiter, insurance in November, PUC every six months
